$comment: #EXP-1926 / #EXP-1944 (Danny 2026-11-17 + 2026-11-18): COPY IMAGE ×4 (web incl. mobile web, desktop, eDE, iOS, Android; the five genUI renderers alike) and WHICH PICTURES LOAD. TS reference `src/image-actions.ts`; the copy reaches Swift/Kotlin/Rust through `DomainContract.generated.*` (`imageActions*` / `IMAGE_ACTIONS_*`, scripts/generate.ts); every platform part replays `menuCases`, `pressCases`, `encodingCases`, `shareNameCases` and `sourceCases`. THE MENU: a content picture (`views.in`) answers the platform's EXISTING menu gesture with ITS OWN menu; no new component, no button, no genUI catalogue prop (genUI `Image` always has it). `gestures`: right-click (`contextmenu`) on a pointer, long-press on touch, through each platform's existing machinery: web `menuProps`/`MenuGestureHost` (packages/ui/src/menu.tsx; the event's pointer type decides the input: a mouse right-click = pointer, a touch long-press = touch), desktop the gpui-component context menu (eDE = the desktop app and eui-gpui, nothing of its own), iOS `glassLongPressMenu` over GlassMenu, Android `GlassDropdownMenu` opened by `combinedClickable(onLongClick)`, inside genUI the `Menu openOn: contextmenu` machinery of each renderer. `inputs` = which inputs each platform has. A TAP keeps doing what it does today (open the viewer, or nothing); the gesture never steals a tap, a drag, a pinch or a text selection that started off the picture. ITEMS (`imageMenu(input, canShareFile)`, `menus`, `menuCases`): pointer = `copy.copyImage` only; touch = `copy.copyImage` then `copy.share`; Share needs the platform to share a FILE (iOS + Android always; mobile web only when `navigator.canShare({files: [png]})` says yes, else it is dropped). Icons = concepts `icons.copyImage` (ui-copy) and `icons.share` (ui-share), testIds `testIds.*`. THE MENU OF THE PRESS (`pressMenu(onImage, imageReady, ownerMenu)`, `pressCases`): a press ON a picture whose bytes have rendered (`imageReady`) opens the IMAGE menu, never merged with the menu of the element around it (a message bubble's Retry/Delete/Cancel, a row's menu); a press elsewhere on that element, or on a picture still loading, failed or blocked (a link, below), opens the element's own menu (`owner`), else nothing (`none`, and on the web the browser's own menu stays suppressed only where the element already suppressed it). VIEWS (`views`): IN = Markdown images in every read view (issue descriptions, comments, chat, agent replies, plan text), genUI `Image` and the slides of genUI Carousel/Mosaic, genUI ZoomableImage, the full-screen viewer / lightbox (the picture on screen), inline result tiles and the results tab (result + PR pictures), plan page pictures, comment attachment tiles, chat attachment thumbnails, the chat picture row. OUT (Danny decided) = avatars (UserAvatar, genUI Avatar), team marks, MCP and brand icons, video posters, the composer's pending thumbnails, plan option tiles (tap = pick), Motion and canvas. Editor image blocks in EDIT mode (web TipTap `MarkdownImage` `…` menu, the desktop editor's right-click) keep their own block menu; its Copy image item uses this fixture's wording, copy rule and toasts. COPY (`copyFormat`, `copyEncoding(head)`, `encodingCases`): the picture's BYTES go to the clipboard as an image (pasteable into another app as a picture), never its URL and never a URL fallback; mime `image/png`: bytes that start with the PNG signature go as they are, anything else is decoded and re-encoded to PNG (an animated GIF/WebP = its first frame); never downscaled (the original, not a thumbnail: the thumbnail width parameter `w` is dropped from the query for the copy fetch, any other parameter stays). The bytes come through the platform's EXISTING authenticated loader (web a same-origin fetch with the cookie, `ClipboardItem({'image/png': promise})` started inside the gesture; iOS AttachmentImageLoader / the genUI host's mediaRequest with the bearer; Android Coil + InstanceUrlInterceptor / the card host's bearer rule; desktop the api client), cache first. Success = THE success toast (toast-stack.json, kind `toasts.copied`) `copy.copied`; ANY failure (load, decode, encode, a clipboard that refuses images, e.g. a platform without image clipboard support) = THE error toast `copy.copyFailed` (feedback-states.json: a failed action = toast). SHARE (phones only): the system share sheet (iOS ActivityShareSheet, Android ACTION_SEND over the FileProvider, web `navigator.share({files})`) with the PNG FILE (the same bytes as Copy), never a link; its file name = `shareFileName(name)` (`shareNameCases`: the attachment's file name with its last extension replaced by `.png`, path separators as `-`, an empty stem or no name = `image.png`); a person cancelling the sheet shows nothing; a failure = THE error toast `copy.shareFailed`. WHICH SOURCES LOAD (`imageSource(src, alt, origin)`, `sourcePolicy`, `sourceCases` against `sourcePolicy.origin`; Danny 2026-11-18 "block them, show a link"): applies to every Markdown image (read views, the chat, plan text, and the editors' image blocks, which then show the same link in place of the picture while the Markdown keeps its bytes) and to genUI `Image` (+ slides, ZoomableImage) in cards, results and plan cards (each host narrows the SDK's media policy with it). App screens keep apps.json's stricter `appMediaAllowed` (no query); avatars and MCP icons are NOT affected. The src is trimmed of surrounding ASCII whitespace; any other whitespace or control character left = not a url. `load` = (a) OUR ATTACHMENT: `/api/attachments/<uuid>` relative (starting with one `/`), or absolute on the viewer's instance origin exactly as written (scheme + host case-insensitive, the origin's port as written: an explicit default port is another origin; no credentials), the path exactly `/api/attachments/` (case-sensitive) + a uuid (hex case-insensitive), then nothing or a `?query` and/or `#fragment`; no dot segment, percent-encoding, trailing slash or extra segment; (b) a `data:` url (scheme case-insensitive) with a comma whose mime (before the first `;` or `,`, case-insensitive) is `image/<subtype>` except `image/svg+xml`; (c) a LOCAL / app-provided source: `blob:` or `app-file:` (case-insensitive), or bytes the platform holds already (picked, decoded). Nothing else is EVER fetched (no request, no preload, no thumbnail). `link` = any other `https://`, `http://` or protocol-relative `//` url with a non-empty host (another website, another port, http, credentials, a lookalike host, even `//` on our own host): it renders as an ORDINARY LINK in the picture's place (inline in prose, the Markdown link look; in a genUI surface THE link look of the renderer), text = the alt trimmed when non-empty, else `copy.linkHost` with {host} = the url's host lowercased, userinfo and port dropped, IPv6 brackets kept; href = the src as written (trimmed), a `//` src gets `https:`; a press opens it through THE existing external-link path (prose-links.json / the platform's link handler), never the viewer, and it carries no image menu. `text` = everything else (svg data, other data, `file:`, `javascript:`, other schemes, relative paths that are not an attachment, a url without a host, a src with whitespace inside): never fetched, never a link; the alt trimmed as plain text, nothing when the alt is empty. A `load` source that then fails keeps today's failed-image rendering.
